sections.light_dependent: Light-dependent reactions occur in the thylakoid membrane, producing ATP and NADPH.
sections.calvin_cycle: The Calvin cycle (light-independent reactions) occurs in the stroma and fixes CO2 into glucose using ATP/NADPH from the light reactions.
